<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission controversy:</strong> Opposition parties and the Indian People&#x27;s Front have launched protests and hunger strikes alleging bias within the Election Commission, while the BJP has mounted a counter-offensive accusing the Congress of manufacturing lies to undermine the institution.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOZTdoVmRLRGhuT0JQLTlQOGFXakZXV2RZeUlWZEt4aGdHbFhSaWhLR3ZyVXB4RXdFdW5NLTRGN1VRckRRSU9pbzRsUmhBdjVqMTlrUE9vSVRXYkZsdWhtZThXc1NKZ1lSeDVDeEhKZHBvcXBGZFdWdHRrNV80ZExmVExsNHNxdGhwbW52ZVRCMlNJZHFaLUNJYg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQVERTQ09wc1Y1ZWhBem80OHJhWUFQMlpFaE9CTU5ERDJmRDY5aTR6dTBnSm5fY2JEVk9nUkVvOEhNaklySDNHa1d5VlM4VkIwWnQzaVpONWFlOXRraElZbWttdGtxRFdoYXZBZ095cnFtSjNCTE4xOGZuaGI0M3lUSmxBVUdGMWltdjVpblZwYTdRZnNFcElv?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Electoral preparations:</strong> As the BJP core committee meets in Lucknow to finalize Rajya Sabha candidates, SP leader Akhilesh Yadav has opted to skip an upcoming INDIA bloc meeting to focus on his own party&#x27;s Rajya Sabha poll preparations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Allegations against officials:</strong> Former Kerala Chief Secretary claims Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar previously suggested he contest Lok Sabha elections on a BJP ticket, further fueling the ongoing political row.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>
